question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A person who easily believes without demanding proof
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'**** **i.e. **'Credulous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given group of words describes *'A person who easily believes without demanding proof'* (बिना प्रमाण के आसानी से विश्वास करने वाला व्यक्ति).
 
• The correct word is** 'Credulous'** (भोला-भाला, विश्वासी), which refers to having or showing too great a readiness to believe things.

Therefore, the correct answer is- 'Credulous'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cosmopolitan** (विश्ववासी) - Familiar with and at ease in many different countries and cultures.
 
• **Wary **(सतर्क) - Feeling or showing caution about possible dangers or problems.
 
• **Streetwise (**सड़क का अनुभवी) - Having the experience and knowledge necessary to deal with the potential difficulties or dangers of urban life.

36:T405,The correct answer is **'Option 3'**
